attributes.comment:
On behalf of the Professional Services Council (PSC), I am pleased to submit comments on the Department of Defense (DoD) proposed rule entitled “Defense Federal Acquisition Regulation Supplement: Assessing Contractor Implementation of Cybersecurity Requirements (DFARS Case 2019-D041),” as published in the Federal Register on August 15, 2024.

Please see the attached file for these comments.
